resources.string: Configure grace buffer periods and midnight cutoff time for overnight shift overtime calculation.
Grace period prior to scheduled work start
Disregard any work done prior to official start time.
• Early clock-ins disabled: All early arrival time is ignored (0 early overtime).
• No buffer: ALL early arrival time counts as overtime.
• Clocking in within %1$d mins before start is treated as arrival grace time and excluded from overtime.
Grace period after scheduled work end
• No buffer: ALL late departure time counts as overtime.
• Clocking out within %1$d mins after end is treated as departure grace time and excluded from overtime.
• If clock out passes midnight but is earlier than or equal to %1$s, extra hours are counted into the day before midnight.

Non-work day (All worked time is extra)
Non-working day log: Entire worked duration is calculated as overtime.

Healthiness assessment based on monthly overtime strain and occupational health resources.
Low monthly overtime strain (%1$s). Your work-rest balance is within a healthy, sustainable range. Continue prioritizing regular downtime.
Noticeable overtime accumulated (%1$s). Keep an eye on workload levels and ensure you take adequate micro-breaks during long shifts.
Significant overtime logged (%1$s). You are experiencing heightened strain. Consider discussing workload bounds with your supervisor to prevent exhaustion.
Extreme overtime load (%1$s). Prolonged overtime at this level poses a high risk of burnout and chronic fatigue. Immediate recovery rest is strongly advised.
Overtime fatigue can build up subtly before impacting daily mental health. Watch for these physical and psychological warning signs:
• Chronic Physical Exhaustion: Persistent fatigue even after a night of sleep.
• Cognitive Fog: Reduced focus, increased errors, or delayed decision-making.
• Emotional Detachment: Feeling cynicism, irritability, or loss of work fulfillment.
• Sleep Disruption: Difficulty falling asleep due to work-related stress or late clock-outs.
Actionable micro-habits to protect mental clarity when working extended hours:
• Micro-Break Cadence: Take 3–5 minute breathing breaks every 90 minutes of focused work.
• Digital Off-Switch: Set strict boundaries against checking work emails or chats after clock-out.
• Post-Shift Wind-down: Engage in a non-screen transition routine (e.g. walk, light stretch) before sleep.
• Hydration & Nutrition: Sustained energy requires steady hydration and balanced meals during night shifts.
Instant Stress Reduction: Box Breathing Method
Use the 4-4-4-4 Box Breathing technique when feeling overwhelmed on shift:
1. Inhale through your nose slowly for 4 seconds.
3. Exhale smoothly through your mouth for 4 seconds.
4. Pause and hold empty for 4 seconds before the next breath.
If work-related stress affects your personal health or relationships, reach out to professional resources:
• Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Confidential counseling provided by many employers.
• Occupational Health Services: Workplace health advisors specializing in shift-work safety.
• Healthcare Professionals: Consult your general practitioner for mental health support.
Learn about the architecture, framework, and licensing powering Shift Tracker, designed to support work-life balance and mental wellbeing.

This app is built using modern Jetpack Compose and strictly adheres to Material Design 3 guidelines. It features elegant component styling, support for edge-to-edge rendering, accessible touch targets, and a cohesive theme utilizing M3 tonal elevations and generous negative space.

The entire codebase is written in Kotlin. It leverages Kotlin\'s advanced features, including absolute type safety, structured concurrency with Coroutines and Flow for seamless reactive state updates, and standard modern coding practices.

Your data stays private and secure. The application integrates an offline SQLite database via Android Jetpack Room. This ensures reliable offline data persistence, atomic database transactions, and smooth local state management without relying on external cloud APIs.
